description.message: Saves a page, link, text, image or screenshot to your Rozcestník.

pasteHint.message: Ctrl+V attaches an image from the clipboard.

needSetup.message: First enter the address of your Rozcestník.

errNetwork.message: Rozcestník is unreachable. Are you online and is the address right?

optHint.message: The one you open in the browser, e.g. https://rozcestnik.your-account.workers.dev. The browser will ask whether the extension may send data to this address — it sends nothing anywhere else.

optBad.message: That doesn't look like an address.

optDenied.message: Without permission the extension can't send anything to Rozcestník.

optUnreachable.message: Saved, but Rozcestník doesn't respond at that address. Check it.

optKeys.message: Shortcuts: Alt+Shift+S opens the popup, Alt+Shift+D saves the page directly. Change them in about:addons → gear icon → Manage Extension Shortcuts.
